title: पार्टीभित्रको आन्तरिक प्रतिस्पर्धामा हार्नेलाई पनि क्षमताअनुसारको जिम्मेवारी दिन्छौँ : गगन थापा
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेपाली कांग्रेसका सभापति गगन थापाले पार्टीभित्र जिम्मेवारी नपाएका नेता तथा कार्यकर्तालाई पनि समेटेर नयाँ ढङ्गले पार्टी सञ्चालन गर्ने बताएका छन्। स्याङ्जामा आयोजित स्वागत तथा कार्यकर्ता भेटघाट कार्यक्रममा बोल्दै पार्टीभित्रको आन्तरिक प्रतिस्पर्धामा कोही जित्ने र कोही हार्नेभन्दा पनि सबैलाई जिम्मेवारी र अवसर प्रदान गर्दै अघि बढ्नुपर्ने बताए। उनले कांग्रेस चार पुस्ताको पार्टी भएको बताए। केन्द्रीय समितिमा प्रतिस्पर्धा गरेका तथा वडा र क्षेत्रदेखि विभिन्न तहमा जिम्मेवारी प्राप्त गर्न नसकेका साथीहरूलाई पनि अन्य जिम्मेवारी दिएर सक्रिय बनाइने बताए। उनले भने, ‘पार्टीभित्रको आन्तरिक प्रतिस्पर्धामा एक जनाले जित्ने र अर्कोले हार्ने भन्ने हुँदैन। हामी सबै समान हैसियत राख्छौँ। मैले अहिले प्राप्त गरेको कुरा जिम्मेवारी मात्र हो, यो स्थायी पद होइन।’ उनले क्षेत्रीय, जिल्ला, प्रदेश र केन्द्रमा जिम्मेवारी प्राप्त गर्न नसकेका कार्यकर्तालाई लामो समयसम्म भूमिकाविहीन बनाएर राख्ने परिपाटी अन्त्य गर्नुपर्नेमा जोड दिए। काम गर्ने इच्छा, क्षमता र योग्यता भएका साथीहरूलाई विधानअनुसार पार्टीका विभिन्न तहमा जिम्मेवारी दिइने उनले बताए। पार्टीभित्र पदका आधारमा ठूलो सानो ठान्ने, आसन ग्रहण र प्राथमिकताका विषयमा विभेद गर्ने परम्परालाई समेत परिवर्तन गर्नुपर्ने बताए। पार्टीका आगामी अधिवेशन र आन्तरिक संरचनाबारे अनावश्यक चिन्ता गर्नुभन्दा तत्काल जनतामाझ पुग्नुपर्नेमा जोड दिए। नयाँ समितिले नयाँ सोच र प्रतिबद्धतासहित जनतासँग सम्बन्ध विस्तार गर्नुपर्ने बताए। मंसिर महिनाभित्रै पार्टीबाट टाढिएका परिवार तथा मतदाताको घरसम्म पुग्ने अभियान सञ्चालन गर्न नेता तथा कार्यकर्तालाई आग्रह गरे। उनले थपे, ‘पहिले कांग्रेसमा रहेका तर अहिले पार्टीमा नरहेका परिवारलाई भेट्नुपर्छ, चिन्नुपर्छ र उनीहरूको घरमा पुग्नुपर्छ।’ कांग्रेसबाट टाढिएका करिब १० लाख मानिससम्म पुग्ने लक्ष्यसहित पार्टीले काम गर्नुपर्ने बताए। पार्टीका संस्थापक नेताहरूले स्थापित गरेका मूल्य र मान्यताबाट विचलित नभई वर्तमान समयका चुनौती र युवापुस्ताका प्रश्नको सम्बोधन गर्न सक्ने कांग्रेस निर्माण गर्नुपर्ने उनले बताए। आन्तरिक प्रतिस्पर्धाको चरण सकिएकाले अब पार्टी एकढिक्का भएर सङ्गठन सुदृढीकरण र जनताको विश्वास जित्ने अभियानमा लाग्नुपर्ने बताए। Kathmandu. Nepali Congress President Gagan Thapa has said that the party will be run in a new way by including leaders and cadres who have not been given responsibilities within the party. Speaking at a reception and cadre meeting program organized in Syangja, he said that instead of looking for someone to win and someone to lose in the internal competition within the party, everyone should move forward by providing responsibilities and opportunities. He said that the Nepali Congress is a four-generation party. He said that friends who competed in the central committee and could not get responsibilities at various levels from ward to constituency will also be made active by giving them other responsibilities. He said, "In the internal competition within the party, there is no such thing as one person winning and the other losing. We all have equal status. What I have received now is only a responsibility, it is not a permanent position." He stressed the need to end the practice of keeping cadres who have not been able to obtain responsibilities at the regional, district, provincial and central levels without roles for a long time. He said that comrades who have the desire, ability and qualifications to work will be given responsibilities at various levels of the party as per the statute. He said that the tradition of considering people big and small based on positions within the party, and discriminating on matters of seating and priorities, should also be changed. He stressed the need to reach out to the people immediately rather than worrying unnecessarily about the upcoming party convention and internal structure. He said that the new committee should expand its relations with the people with new thinking and commitment. He urged leaders and cadres to launch a campaign to reach the homes of families and voters who have distanced themselves from the party within the month of Mangsir. He added, "We should meet and get to know the families who were previously in the Congress but are not in the party now, and reach their homes." He said that the party should work with the goal of reaching out to about one million people who have distanced themselves from the Congress. He said that the Congress should be built that can address the challenges of the present time and the questions of the youth generation without straying from the values and norms established by the party's founding leaders. He said that now that the phase of internal competition is over, the party should unite and embark on a campaign to strengthen the organization and win the trust of the people.

पार्टीका आगामी अधिवेशन र आन्तरिक संरचनाबारे अनावश्यक चिन्ता गर्नुभन्दा तत्काल जनतामाझ पुग्नुपर्नेमा जोड दिए। नयाँ समितिले नयाँ सोच र प्रतिबद्धतासहित जनतासँग सम्बन्ध विस्तार गर्नुपर्ने बताए। मंसिर महिनाभित्रै पार्टीबाट टाढिएका परिवार तथा मतदाताको घरसम्म पुग्ने अभियान सञ्चालन गर्न नेता तथा कार्यकर्तालाई आग्रह गरे। उनले थपे, ‘पहिले कांग्रेसमा रहेका तर अहिले पार्टीमा नरहेका परिवारलाई भेट्नुपर्छ, चिन्नुपर्छ र उनीहरूको घरमा पुग्नुपर्छ।’ कांग्रेसबाट टाढिएका करिब १० लाख मानिससम्म पुग्ने लक्ष्यसहित पार्टीले काम गर्नुपर्ने बताए। पार्टीका संस्थापक नेताहरूले स्थापित गरेका मूल्य र मान्यताबाट विचलित नभई वर्तमान समयका चुनौती र युवापुस्ताका प्रश्नको सम्बोधन गर्न सक्ने कांग्रेस निर्माण गर्नुपर्ने उनले बताए। आन्तरिक प्रतिस्पर्धाको चरण सकिएकाले अब पार्टी एकढिक्का भएर सङ्गठन सुदृढीकरण र जनताको विश्वास जित्ने अभियानमा लाग्नुपर्ने बताए। Kathmandu. Nepali Congress President Gagan Thapa has said that the party will be run in a new way by including leaders and cadres who have not been given responsibilities within the party. Speaking at a reception and cadre meeting program organized in Syangja, he said that instead of looking for someone to win and someone to lose in the internal competition within the party, everyone should move forward by providing responsibilities and opportunities. He said that the Nepali Congress is a four-generation party. He said that friends who competed in the central committee and could not get responsibilities at various levels from ward to constituency will also be made active by giving them other responsibilities. He said, "In the internal competition within the party, there is no such thing as one person winning and the other losing. We all have equal status. What I have received now is only a responsibility, it is not a permanent position." He stressed the need to end the practice of keeping cadres who have not been able to obtain responsibilities at the regional, district, provincial and central levels without roles for a long time. He said that comrades who have the desire, ability and qualifications to work will be given responsibilities at various levels of the party as per the statute. He said that the tradition of considering people big and small based on positions within the party, and discriminating on matters of seating and priorities, should also be changed. He stressed the need to reach out to the people immediately rather than worrying unnecessarily about the upcoming party convention and internal structure. He said that the new committee should expand its relations with the people with new thinking and commitment. He urged leaders and cadres to launch a campaign to reach the homes of families and voters who have distanced themselves from the party within the month of Mangsir. He added, "We should meet and get to know the families who were previously in the Congress but are not in the party now, and reach their homes." He said that the party should work with the goal of reaching out to about one million people who have distanced themselves from the Congress. He said that the Congress should be built that can address the challenges of the present time and the questions of the youth generation without straying from the values and norms established by the party's founding leaders. He said that now that the phase of internal competition is over, the party should unite and embark on a campaign to strengthen the organization and win the trust of the people.

उनले क्षेत्रीय, जिल्ला, प्रदेश र केन्द्रमा जिम्मेवारी प्राप्त गर्न नसकेका कार्यकर्तालाई लामो समयसम्म भूमिकाविहीन बनाएर राख्ने परिपाटी अन्त्य गर्नुपर्नेमा जोड दिए। काम गर्ने इच्छा, क्षमता र योग्यता भएका साथीहरूलाई विधानअनुसार पार्टीका विभिन्न तहमा जिम्मेवारी दिइने उनले बताए।

पार्टीभित्र पदका आधारमा ठूलो सानो ठान्ने, आसन ग्रहण र प्राथमिकताका विषयमा विभेद गर्ने परम्परालाई समेत परिवर्तन गर्नुपर्ने बताए।

पार्टीका आगामी अधिवेशन र आन्तरिक संरचनाबारे अनावश्यक चिन्ता गर्नुभन्दा तत्काल जनतामाझ पुग्नुपर्नेमा जोड दिए। नयाँ समितिले नयाँ सोच र प्रतिबद्धतासहित जनतासँग सम्बन्ध विस्तार गर्नुपर्ने बताए।

मंसिर महिनाभित्रै पार्टीबाट टाढिएका परिवार तथा मतदाताको घरसम्म पुग्ने अभियान सञ्चालन गर्न नेता तथा कार्यकर्तालाई आग्रह गरे। उनले थपे, ‘पहिले कांग्रेसमा रहेका तर अहिले पार्टीमा नरहेका परिवारलाई भेट्नुपर्छ, चिन्नुपर्छ र उनीहरूको घरमा पुग्नुपर्छ।’

कांग्रेसबाट टाढिएका करिब १० लाख मानिससम्म पुग्ने लक्ष्यसहित पार्टीले काम गर्नुपर्ने बताए। पार्टीका संस्थापक नेताहरूले स्थापित गरेका मूल्य र मान्यताबाट विचलित नभई वर्तमान समयका चुनौती र युवापुस्ताका प्रश्नको सम्बोधन गर्न सक्ने कांग्रेस निर्माण गर्नुपर्ने उनले बताए। आन्तरिक प्रतिस्पर्धाको चरण सकिएकाले अब पार्टी एकढिक्का भएर सङ्गठन सुदृढीकरण र जनताको विश्वास जित्ने अभियानमा लाग्नुपर्ने बताए।

Kathmandu. Nepali Congress President Gagan Thapa has said that the party will be run in a new way by including leaders and cadres who have not been given responsibilities within the party. Speaking at a reception and cadre meeting program organized in Syangja, he said that instead of looking for someone to win and someone to lose in the internal competition within the party, everyone should move forward by providing responsibilities and opportunities. He said that the Nepali Congress is a four-generation party. He said that friends who competed in the central committee and could not get responsibilities at various levels from ward to constituency will also be made active by giving them other responsibilities. He said, "In the internal competition within the party, there is no such thing as one person winning and the other losing. We all have equal status. What I have received now is only a responsibility, it is not a permanent position." He stressed the need to end the practice of keeping cadres who have not been able to obtain responsibilities at the regional, district, provincial and central levels without roles for a long time. He said that comrades who have the desire, ability and qualifications to work will be given responsibilities at various levels of the party as per the statute. He said that the tradition of considering people big and small based on positions within the party, and discriminating on matters of seating and priorities, should also be changed. He stressed the need to reach out to the people immediately rather than worrying unnecessarily about the upcoming party convention and internal structure. He said that the new committee should expand its relations with the people with new thinking and commitment. He urged leaders and cadres to launch a campaign to reach the homes of families and voters who have distanced themselves from the party within the month of Mangsir. He added, "We should meet and get to know the families who were previously in the Congress but are not in the party now, and reach their homes." He said that the party should work with the goal of reaching out to about one million people who have distanced themselves from the Congress. He said that the Congress should be built that can address the challenges of the present time and the questions of the youth generation without straying from the values and norms established by the party's founding leaders. He said that now that the phase of internal competition is over, the party should unite and embark on a campaign to strengthen the organization and win the trust of the people.
